thread:
maya: Quick heads-up — planning to deploy v1.8.3 to hosted tomorrow at 10:00 AM PT. Main changes: batching improvements + a small schema tweak for embeddings. Can CS/Marketing confirm release notes and support playbook? Who's taking the deploy?

liam: I can run the deploy and own the smoke checks. Will start the canary at 10:00, fully roll at 10:15 if green.

devon: pinging to confirm rollback tag is ready: `v1.8.2-stable`. Also have the rollback playbook in case KV cache misbehaves.

jess (support): Thanks — we'll need a short TL;DR and a list of probable user-facing errors + remediation steps. Can you drop the release notes link here?

paul (marketing): Need a single-paragraph summary and 3 bullets on customer impact. Also any visuals? Want to schedule the announcement 12:30 PM PT.

sophia: Canary config: 5% traffic for first 5 mins, 25% next 10 mins, then 100% if metrics OK. Watch: latency p50/p95, error rate, kv-cache miss rate.

liam: noted. Smoke checklist I'll run:
```
- sanity endpoints: /health, /generate (sample prompt)
- check KV cache hit ratio > baseline
- p50 < 120ms, p95 < 500ms
- no increase in 5xx across routes
- log tail for exceptions
```

maya: jess — I'll add a quick canned response draft. paul — attaching short summary after this thread.

ops-bot: Deploy job scheduled by @liam: `deploy-hosted-v1.8.3` — ETA 2026-01-14T17:00:00Z. Status: queued.

liam: ops-bot shows queued. I'll kick off manual canary at 10:00 PT and post updates here. If anything looks off I will `rollback to v1.8.2-stable` and notify.

jess (support): Received — prep'ing a support playbook and canned responses. Will post in #support once ready.

paul (marketing): Great. Please include one customer-facing sentence on cost/latency improvements. Also, any breaking changes?

sophia: No breaking changes. Small schema tweak only affects internal embeddings metadata; backward-compatible.

devon: Reminder: retention window for experiment metrics is 48hrs. If we see regressions, capture traces and tag the deploy.

liam: Will post canary metrics at +5m and +15m. If p95 > 700ms or error rate > 0.5% I'll pause and roll back.

maya: Thanks all. Plan:
- 10:00 PT: start canary (5%) — liam
- 10:05 PT: canary check-in — liam/sophia
- 10:15 PT: ramp to 100% if green — liam
- 12:30 PT: marketing announcement — paul
- Support playbook posted before 10:00 PT — jess

maya: If anyone can't make their part, call it out now. Otherwise we'll proceed tomorrow. :thumbsup:
